verdict.rationale: An interactive API reference with runnable examples is a fair capability to expect from a backend platform like Firebase, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents an API explorer, try-it console or runnable reference examples. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path, and the MCP server, CLI, emulators and Gemini chat are separate features that don't count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
